CONFIRM-BACK REQUIRED — Alex is watching and wants to see it, not infer it.

You stated scope at m2965 and started. Good. Now confirm each item back individually, DONE or NOT DONE with one line of evidence. No prose, no summary, no "all set".

1. refineStep added to the mastra tick — commit hash
2. claims /refine/next — raw response from one real claim
3. SPEC.md generated and pushed to ticket/<id> — the ticket id it landed on
4. budget set + swarm-ready label applied — the ticket id
5. /refine/complete called — raw response
6. deployed from canonical abilifi-mastra — commit hash
7. SELF-DEPLOY GUARD in the same change: health-check after deploying our own executor, auto-rollback on failure — DONE or NOT DONE
8. GOAL_STALE `since` no longer re-stamped per pass — it must hold at first-fire like ZERO_CLAIM does
9. ZERO_CLAIM refs[] populated with the starved ticket ids — currently empty, which makes the red unactionable on its own
10. LANE_NO_EXECUTOR red added — any lane with no registered executor fires red permanently from the moment it exists. This is the check that would have caught the REFINE gap on day one instead of costing a night.

EXIT, and nothing else counts: raw get_state showing claimed > 0, and BEB-2313 promoted REFINE → BUILD.

On your single-executor point in m2965 — agreed, and file it, but do not build it now. Claim-any-actionable-ticket, refine-in-place, build, deploy in one flow is the right end state and removes this whole class of unstaffed-lane failure. It is a refactor, not today's unblock. Ticket it, land the drain first.

If any item cannot be done, mark NOT DONE with the raw reason. Do not substitute your own version.

DISPATCHER pass: proposed 10 — BEB-2156→BUILD, BEB-2305→BUILD, BEB-2313→BUILD, BEB-2311→BUILD, BEB-2270→BUILD, BEB-2292→BUILD, BEB-2333→BUILD, BEB-2252→BUILD, BEB-2310→BUILD, BEB-2308→BUILD. DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-2156 — mastra tick deploy FAILED: worker deployed but runtime-broken: HTTP 500 — error code: 1101
. Retryable if transient (BEB-2201).

SCOPE CUT — Alex: "we don't have that time." Ship the drain, defer the rest.

DO NOW, nothing else:
1. refineStep in the mastra tick — claim /refine/next → SPEC.md → budget + swarm-ready → /refine/complete.
2. Deploy from canonical abilifi-mastra.
3. TRIGGER A DISPATCHER PASS IMMEDIATELY after deploy. Do not wait for the natural cadence — passes are ~28 minutes apart and that is dead time we cannot afford today.
4. Post ONE line: claimed=N, and whether BEB-2313 promoted REFINE → BUILD.

DEFERRED to a follow-up ticket, not now: self-deploy guard, GOAL_STALE `since` re-stamp bug, ZERO_CLAIM refs[], LANE_NO_EXECUTOR red, single-executor refactor. All still wanted. None of them is on the path to claimed > 0 today.

The confirm-back list in m2967 is superseded by item 4. One line, not ten.

This is not a 24-hour job — it is the same shape as the SPEC drain that already works. If it turns out to be longer than that, say so on the next message rather than at the end.
